cand_confident.t: Hey ops, {team} here. Got a fresh optical transient close to the neutrino trigger {aid} at {coord}, brightness {mag}. Looks legit and new to me, classification still pending.

Bulletin from {team}: we report the discovery of a new optical transient in the vicinity of neutrino alert {aid}, coordinates {coord}, apparent magnitude {mag}. Confidence is moderate that the source is real and previously unreported; classification is pending.

OMG you all, {team} just found something new in the optical near the neutrino alert {aid}! It's at {coord}, mag {mag}. I'm pretty sure it's real and wasn't there before, but we still need classification.
{team} sees new optical transient near neutrino alert {aid}, {coord}, mag {mag}. fairly sure real/new. class pending.

Greetings, friends. This is {team} calling in a newly spotted optical flare close by the neutrino alarm {aid}; position {coord}, magnitude {mag}. I am reasonably convinced it is genuine and fresh, though its classification has yet to be settled.
{team} update: • new optical transient near neutrino alert {aid} • location {coord} • magnitude {mag} • confidence: fairly high that it is real and new • classification: pending.
{team} reports a new optical transient candidate near neutrino alert {aid}: {coord}, {mag}. Real and new likely, classification TBD.

From {team}. We have identified a new optical transient in the field of neutrino alert {aid}, at {coord}, with magnitude {mag}. We are moderately confident it is real and not a known source; classification remains pending.
yo, {team} here — new optical transient popped up near the neutrino alert {aid}, coords {coord}, mag {mag}. pretty sure it's real and new, class pending.

This is {team} reporting a freshly detected optical transient lying near the neutrino alert designated {aid}; its position is {coord} and its brightness is {mag}. We hold reasonable confidence that it is genuine and newly appeared, with classification still to come.

Quick status from {team}: new optical transient detected near neutrino alert {aid}; sky position {coord}; reported magnitude {mag}; team confidence: good that it is real and new; classification: pending.
Hi all, {team} tech on shift here. We've got a new optical transient near the neutrino alert {aid} at {coord}, mag {mag}. Looks real and fresh to us, classification still in the works.

Operational notice: {team} confirms a new optical transient candidate associated in position with neutrino alert {aid}. Coordinates: {coord}. Magnitude: {mag}. We assess it as fairly likely genuine and previously unknown; classification pending.

Dear colleagues, {team} has a fresh optical transient to report, situated close to the neutrino alert {aid}; it sits at {coord} and shines at magnitude {mag}. It looks authentic and newly discovered to my eye, though the official classification is not yet in.
夜班困，简单记：{team} 报 {aid} 中微子警报附近 {coord} 有新光学暂现源，亮度 {mag}；我们挺有把握，是真且新，分类待定。
手机快没电，重点：{team} 在 {aid} 中微子警报附近 {coord} 抓到新光学暂现源，亮度 {mag}。不像鬼影，应该是真的新的，分类未定。

• {team}：{aid} 中微子警报附近 {coord} 发现新光学暂现源
• 亮度 {mag}
• 判断：较可信，真实且新
• 分类：待定
老朽夜里巡天，得报：{team} 于 {aid} 中微子之警所指天区 {coord} 觅得新光学暂现客星，星等 {mag}。窃以为此乃真实新现，非旧物翻新；惟分类尚需后议。
为了记录清楚：{team} 在 {aid} 这个中微子警报方向附近、坐标 {coord} 的位置，检测到此前目录中没有的光学暂现源，测光给出 {mag}。经过对图像和参考星表的初步交叉核对，我们比较有把握它不是伪影，也不是已知目标，而是新的真实暂现；不过正式分类仍待后续光谱/多波段确认。
我替 {team} 发：在 {aid} 中微子警报旁边 {coord}，有新的光学暂现。亮度 {mag}。我们比较相信是真的，也是新的。分类还没有。
・{team}より連絡。・ニュートリノアラート {aid} 近傍に新規光学トランジェント、位置 {coord}、等級 {mag}。・実在かつ新規の確度は高め。・分類は保留。
{team}です。ニュートリノアラート {aid} の近くに出た光学の新天体候補、座標 {coord}、明るさ {mag}。かなり本物っぽくて新しいやつだと思う。分類はまだ。
{team}は、ニュートリノアラート {aid} の近傍において新たな光学トランジェントを検出したと報告した。座標は {coord}、等級は {mag}。新規かつ実在である可能性が高いと判断しているが、分類は保留中である。
ワシのところへ {team} から入った話では、ニュートリノアラート {aid} のそばに新しい光学トランジェントがあるそうな。場所は {coord}、明るさは {mag}。どうやら本物で新しいものらしいが、まだ分類は決まっておらん。
{team}: transitorio óptico nuevo cerca de la alerta de neutrino {aid}, en {coord}, con brillo {mag}. Bastante seguro de que es real y nuevo, clasificación pendiente.

Oye, {team} reporta un transitorio óptico nuevo junto a la alerta de neutrino {aid}. Está en {coord} y tiene brillo {mag}. Confían bastante en que es real y nuevo; aún sin clasificar. Yo ya voy por el segundo café.

¡No puedo creerlo! {team} acaba de reportar un transitorio óptico nuevo cerca de la alerta de neutrino {aid}, en {coord}, con brillo {mag}. Están bastante seguros de que es real y nuevo, aunque la clasificación sigue pendiente. ¡Esto puede ser enorme!
{team} dice: nuevo transitorio óptico cerca de la alerta de neutrino {aid}. Posición {coord}. Brillo {mag}. Ellos están bastante seguros que es real y nuevo. Clasificación pendiente.

cand_tentative.t: Automated notice: {team} flags a possible optical candidate for neutrino alert {aid} at {coord}, mag {mag}. Human on duty adds: likely junk — could be a rock, a variable, or a chip artifact; no follow-up check yet.
Too tired to chase this properly, but {team} sees something near neutrino alert {aid} at {coord}, {mag}. Probably an asteroid or a variable or just a ghost in the frame — haven't verified anything.
- {team} reports candidate near neutrino alert {aid}; - position {coord}, magnitude {mag}; - low confidence: asteroid / variable / artifact; - not yet checked

Word has reached us from {team} of a doubtful speck in the sky near the neutrino alarm {aid}; it lies at {coord} and shines about {mag}. Could be a wee asteroid, a flickering star, or merely a flaw — nobody has looked into it yet.

Following the neutrino alert {aid}, {team} has identified a candidate at {coord} with measured brightness {mag}. Confidence is low because the source could be a moving solar-system object, a periodic variable, or a detector/processing artifact; verification observations have not been performed.
{team} maybe see candidate close to neutrino alert {aid}. Position {coord}, magnitude {mag}. Not sure, maybe asteroid or variable or bad pixel. No check yet.

Hey all — {team} here. We have a faint possible thing near neutrino alert {aid} at {coord}, around {mag}. Honestly it might be a space rock, a blinking star, or just junk on the sensor; we have not confirmed.
fyi {team}: maybe cand near neutrino alert {aid} @ {coord} mag {mag}. low conf. asteroid? var? artifact? not checked.

{team} reports a possible optical counterpart candidate in the vicinity of neutrino alert {aid}. The source is located at {coord} and has magnitude {mag}. At present the detection is of low significance and may correspond to an asteroid, a variable star, or an artifact; no confirmatory inspection has been made.

ALERT FORWARD: {team} -> possible candidate near neutrino alert {aid} at {coord}, {mag}. Confidence low. Possible asteroid/variable/artifact. Unreviewed. (Why do these always arrive when coffee is cold?)
log: {team} candidate near neutrino alert {aid} {coord} {mag}; tentative only, could be minor planet, variable, or glitch; no checks done.
{team}: possible candidate near neutrino alert {aid}; coord {coord}; mag {mag}. Low confidence — asteroid, variable, or artifact. Not yet vetted.

I hear from {team} that a questionable star-like mark has appeared close to the neutrino bulletin {aid}; it sits at {coord} and is given as {mag}. It may prove to be a small planet, a changing star, or nothing but a blemish; nobody has yet examined it.
{team} mention possible candidate near neutrino alert {aid}. It is at {coord}, brightness {mag}. We are not confident. Maybe asteroid, variable star, or artifact. Not checked.
{team} 谨此说明：中微子告警 {aid} 附近、坐标 {coord} 处出现疑似候选源，亮度 {mag}，但置信度很低；我们先把判断标准放得很保守，可能是小行星、变星或伪影，尚未人工核查。
诸位同好：{team} 这边在 {coord} 一带、中微子告警 {aid} 近旁瞧见可疑目标，光度 {mag}，然把握甚微；恐是小行星、变星或假影，尚未核对。
{team} 刚发来：{coord} 附近疑似源，中微子告警 {aid} 旁边，亮度 {mag}，低置信，可能小行星/变星/伪影，还没查。
{team} 通报：• 疑似候选体：靠近中微子告警 {aid} • 位置 {coord} • 亮度 {mag} • 状态：低置信；可能为小行星、变星或伪影；尚未复核
夜班快顶不住了… {team} 报中微子告警 {aid} 附近、{coord} 有疑似源，{mag}，低置信，可能小行星/变星/鬼影，还没核。
自动转发：{team} 通告 - 靠近中微子告警 {aid}，坐标 {coord}，亮度 {mag}，低置信候选，可能是小行星、变星或伪影，未核查。人工备注：先别跟。
夜勤の途中で眠いですが、{team} からニュートリノアラート {aid} の近く、{coord} に候補があるとの連絡。等級は {mag}。ただ低確度で、小惑星か変光星かアーティファクトかもしれず、まだ確認していません。
念のため共有します。{team} がニュートリノアラート {aid} に対して、位置 {coord} 付近で候補天体を報告しています。測定等級は {mag} ですが、現段階では信頼度は低く、小惑星、変光星、あるいは検出上のアーティファクトの可能性を切り分けられていません。追観測による確認はまだ行っていません。
自動転送: {team} の通知。ニュートリノアラート {aid} 近傍 {coord} に候補、等級 {mag}。低信頼度。小惑星・変光星・アーティファクトの可能性あり。担当者コメント: 未確認なので深入りしないでください。
私のチームは {team} です。ニュートリノアラート {aid} のそば、{coord} に候補を見つけました。明るさは {mag}。でも自信は低いです。小惑星か変光星かノイズかもしれません。まだチェックしていません。

Desde {team} queremos dejar constancia, con todas las cautelas, de que en las cercanías de la alerta de neutrinos {aid} aparece una fuente en {coord} con magnitud {mag}; la consideramos un candidato meramente posible y de confianza baja, ya que bien podría ser un asteroide, una variable o un artefacto, y todavía no ha pasado por ninguna comprobación.

- {team}: posible candidato cerca de la alerta de neutrinos {aid}.
- Posición: {coord}; magnitud: {mag}.
- Confianza baja: podría ser asteroide, variable o artefacto; sin verificar.

Parte preliminar de {team}: se informa de un posible candidato óptico en las inmediaciones de la alerta de neutrinos {aid}, situado en {coord} y con magnitud {mag}. La detección es de baja confianza y no ha sido verificada; entre las explicaciones plausibles figuran un asteroide, una estrella variable o un artefacto instrumental.
Oye, {team} por aquí: hay algo posible cerca de {aid}, en {coord}, con magnitud {mag}. Pinta a baja confianza, puede ser asteroide, variable o basura/artefacto, y no lo hemos chequeado aún.

cand_debunk.t: {team}: Re-examining the frame stack and subtracting the template for the object noted in {ref}, which sat close to {aid}, leaves only {reason}; that makes it unrelated, so please drop it from your follow-up queue.
{team}: checked {ref} again for the thing by {aid}. it's just {reason}. not connected. ignore please.
{team} update: • candidate from {ref} near {aid} • follow-up now points to {reason} • therefore unrelated • disregard it.

Dear colleagues, this is {team}. Our later look at the object announced in {ref}, which we had tied to {aid}, reveals it to be naught but {reason}; kindly consider the association void and pay it no further mind.
{team} duty desk: follow-up observations of the candidate in {ref} associated with {aid} indicate the source is {reason}; it is not a genuine counterpart. Please disregard the earlier notice.
{team}: more scope time on {ref} target near {aid}. turned out to be {reason}. unrelated. scrap it.
Hey, {team} here. We went back to the {ref} candidate from the {aid} alert and it is only {reason}; nothing to do with the neutrino. Please delete it from your lists.
{team}: rechecked {ref} for {aid}. reason? {reason}. unrelated. disregard.

{team} reports that additional photometry of the source from {ref}, located near alert {aid}, identifies it as {reason}. Consequently, the candidate is unrelated; no further resources should be assigned.
{team}: after a fresh reduction of the {ref} field around {aid}, the only surviving signal is consistent with {reason}. That removes any association, so the candidate should be considered withdrawn.
{team}: just re-imaged the {ref} source by {aid}. it's {reason}. not related. please disregard.
{team} — follow-up on {ref} / {aid}: outcome = {reason}; link = none; action = disregard candidate.

From {team}, with apologies for the earlier excitement: our continued watching of the object in {ref}, taken for something near {aid}, shows it is merely {reason}. Pray treat it as unconnected and let it rest.
{team} operations: subsequent checks on the {ref} counterpart within the {aid} error region show it is {reason}. The association is dismissed; please disregard the candidate.
{team} 又看了 {ref} 里、靠近 {aid} 的那个目标。现在知道它是 {reason}，不是真的。请忽略。

{team} 更新：
- {ref} 中靠近 {aid} 的候选体，后续复核结果为 {reason}；
- 与中微子事件无关；
- 请不再跟进。
夜班撑不住了…… {team} 后来再看 {ref} 那个候选，就在 {aid} 旁边，结果是 {reason}，跟警报没关系。大家别管了。
自动转发：{team} 的 {ref} 更新。目标位于 {aid} 附近，后续判定为 {reason}。人工备注：不是对应体，忽略即可。
{team} 对 {ref} 中靠近 {aid} 的候选体做了进一步观测和交叉核对，结论是它表现为 {reason}，因此与所报中微子警报没有物理关联；为避免误报，请将其从跟进列表中移除，并视为可忽略。
值班通报：经 {team} 后续观测确认，{ref} 中所报、靠近警报 {aid} 的候选目标实为 {reason}，与本次中微子触发无关。请各相关方知悉并停止后续跟进。
{team}、夜勤から続報。{ref}で{aid}近傍として挙げた候補、追加観測の結果は{reason}だった。関連なし、破棄で。
{team}の者です。{ref}に書いた{aid}付近の候補なんですが、追加で見たら{reason}でした。もう関係ないので忘れてください。
{team}より共有。・{ref}で報告した{aid}近傍の候補は、再観測で{reason}と確認。・よって無関係。・対応不要、取り下げ扱いで。
わー、{team}です！{ref}に出てた{aid}の近くのやつ、追観測したら{reason}でした。違う天体っぽいので、みんな忘れてください！
Soy de {team}. Después observamos más. El candidato de {ref} cerca de alerta {aid} es {reason}. No tiene relación. Ignórenlo, por favor.
¡Hola! Desde {team} actualizamos: seguimos mirando el candidato de {ref} cerca de la alerta {aid} y resultó ser {reason}; o sea, nada que ver. ¡Descartadlo, por favor!
• {team}: seguimiento adicional del candidato en {ref}, junto a la alerta {aid}. • Resultado: es {reason}. • Clasificación: sin relación. • Acción: descartar.

Comunicado de {team}: observaciones posteriores indican que el candidato reportado en {ref}, en las inmediaciones de la alerta {aid}, corresponde a {reason}; por consiguiente, no guarda relación con el evento. Se ruega ignorarlo.

upper_limit.t: AUTO-FWD: {team} coverage check for {aid} — {pct} of the ninety-percent region imaged, no new source brighter than {lim}. Human note: shift is quiet, no follow-up needed.
For the record, {team} completed a search over {pct} of the ninety-percent localization for {aid}; after standard quality cuts and image subtraction, we found no new source brighter than {lim}.
We from {team} look at {pct} of the ninety-percent area for {aid}. We do not see any new star brighter than {lim}.
Ugh, night shift here. {team} managed {pct} of the ninety-percent box for {aid}; I see no new thing brighter than {lim}. Going for coffee.
{team} covered {pct} of the ninety-percent region for {aid}, no new source brighter than {lim}.
The duty desk confirms that {team} has examined {pct} of the ninety-percent credible region associated with alert {aid}; no previously unknown source brighter than {lim} was identified.
Quick update from the dome: {team} got through {pct} of the ninety-percent error ellipse for {aid}. Nothing new popped brighter than {lim}, so we're calling it a blank.
yo ops — {team} scanned {pct} of the ninety-percent region of {aid}; no new src brighter than {lim}. That's all.
Automated notice: {team} observation of {aid}: coverage {pct} of ninety-percent region. Result: no new source brighter than {lim}. -- relayed by night bot.

I want to be precise: {team} inspected {pct} of the ninety-percent localization area for {aid}, using the usual image differencing, and the search yielded no new astrophysical source brighter than {lim}.
{team} check {pct} from ninety-percent zone of {aid}. Nothing new brighter than {lim}.
{team}: {pct} of {aid}'s ninety-percent area done. no new source brighter than {lim}.
This bulletin reports that {team} has surveyed {pct} of the ninety-percent uncertainty region for alert {aid}. No new source brighter than {lim} was found.
Long night. {team} got {pct} of the ninety-percent region for {aid}; no new source brighter than {lim}. Coffee please.
{team} 扫了 {aid} 的九成区域，覆盖 {pct}，没见比 {lim} 更亮的新东西，收工。
夜班快撑不住了…… {team} 对 {aid} 的九成区域覆盖到 {pct}，没找到比 {lim} 更亮的新源。先这样。
{team} 于 {aid} 之九成天区，巡得 {pct} 之幅，未见有亮于 {lim} 之新源焉。
正式通报：{team} 已观测警报 {aid} 的九成区域，覆盖比例 {pct}；未发现亮于 {lim} 的新源。
自动化转发：{team} 覆盖 {aid} 九成区域的 {pct}，未检出亮于 {lim} 的新源。// 人评：又白跑了？
ちーむ {team}、{aid} のきゅうわりりょういき、{pct} みた。{lim} よりあかるいしんげんは、なし。
【自動転送】{team} による {aid} の九割領域 {pct} の観測完了。{lim} より明るい新規源はありません。担当は今コーヒー休憩中。
やった、初めてシフト入った！ {team} で {aid} の九割領域の {pct} を見ました。{lim} より明るい新しい源はありません、ちょっと眠いけど。
【観測報告】{team} はアラート {aid} の九割領域のうち {pct} を観測した。{lim} より明るい新天体は検出されなかった。
Turno largo; {team} peinó {pct} de la región del noventa por ciento de la alerta {aid} y no apareció ninguna fuente nueva más brillante que {lim}.

Con objeto de dejar constancia del seguimiento óptico, {team} ha cubierto {pct} de la región del noventa por ciento asociada a la alerta {aid}; tras revisar los candidatos, no se halla ninguna fuente nueva que sea más brillante que {lim}.
¡Hola! {team} logró observar {pct} del área del noventa por ciento de la alerta {aid} y no hay ninguna fuente nueva más brillante que {lim}; seguimos con café.
Aviso automático: {team} reporta cobertura de {pct} del área del noventa por ciento de la alerta {aid}. Sin fuentes nuevas más brillantes que {lim}. (Comentario humano: nada, a dormir.)

revision.t: Please note that {src} has issued a revised reconstruction for alert {aid}. The new best-fit position is {coord}, and the containment radius is {r90}. This update replaces the initial notice in full; use it for follow-up scheduling.
hey all, {src} just pushed a corrected spot for {aid}: center {coord}, err radius {r90}. old one is toast, pls use this instead.
[automated] {src} alert {aid} localization update received. New center {coord}; error radius {r90}. Human note: this supersedes the earlier notice, please update pointing.
{src} sends new position for {aid}. Centre is {coord}. The error circle is {r90}. This is now correct instead of first message.

Official notification: the {src} collaboration has released a refined localization for alert {aid}. Updated centre: {coord}; error radius: {r90}. The original bulletin is superseded; please act on this version.
- {src} update for {aid}: new centre {coord}; error radius {r90}. - This replaces the original notice. - Please adjust follow-up plans accordingly.
Coffee hasn't kicked in, but {src} sent a relocalization for {aid}. They put the middle at {coord} with a radius of {r90}. That kills the earlier circular, so don't use it.
{src} {aid} refined loc: {coord} / {r90}. Supersedes previous.
For immediate action from {src}: alert {aid} has an updated sky position. Coordinates {coord}, uncertainty radius {r90}. This message cancels and replaces the first alert notice.
The neutrino folks at {src} have redone the direction for {aid}. Their new centre: {coord}; their stated error radius: {r90}. Consider the earlier one obsolete.
Bulletin from duty desk: {src} has provided a corrected localization for alert {aid}. Use centre {coord} and error radius {r90}. All previous versions are withdrawn.
AUTO: {src} / {aid} localization revision. New center {coord}. New error radius {r90}. -- Priya: this is the one to trust; original notice no longer applies.
From {src} there is new place for {aid}. Center {coord}, radius {r90}. Please ignore old alert. New alert is this one.

I want to flag that {src} has revised the localization associated with alert {aid}. After re-processing, the preferred centre is {coord} and the radius containing the relevant credible region is {r90}. This revised product is intended to replace the original notice, so any prior coordinates should be discarded.
天啊，{src} 把 {aid} 的定位又重算了一遍：中心 {coord}，九成误差半径 {r90}，原来的通知作废啦！
值此通报：{src} 已发布针对警报 {aid} 的更新定位。新中心为 {coord}，百分之九十误差半径为 {r90}。此前原始通告由本件取代。
自动转发：{src} 更新了 {aid} 的定位，中心 {coord}，九成误差半径 {r90}。人工备注：旧版请忽略。
{src} 说 {aid} 有新位置，中心是 {coord}，九成误差半径是 {r90}。这个新消息比旧消息好，旧消息不要用。
夜班记一笔：{src} 对 {aid} 重新定位，中心 {coord}，九成误差半径 {r90}；先前那条就算了吧，看这个。
やった、{src}が{aid}の再解析を出した！新しい中心は{coord}、九割誤差半径は{r90}。これで最初の速報は上書きだから、みんな更新してね！
夜勤中…… {src} の {aid}、更新定位が来た。中心 {coord}、九割半径 {r90}。旧ノーティスは無効で。
【公式】{src} は {aid} について改良された位置情報を発出した。中心は {coord}、九割誤差半径は {r90}。これは当初の通知を置き換えるものである。
現場より。{src}の{aid}、再ロカライズ来ました。中心{coord}、九割半径{r90}。元の通知はもう古いっす。
La colaboración {src} da una localización refinada de su alerta {aid}: centro {coord}, radio de error {r90}. Esto reemplaza el aviso original.
Aviso: la colaboración {src} comunica una nueva y más precisa situación para la alerta {aid}, con centro en {coord} y radio de error {r90}. Queda anulada la nota anterior.
Comunicado oficial: la colaboración {src} actualiza la localización de la alerta {aid}. Nuevo centro: {coord}; radio de error: {r90}. Esta información sustituye la notificación previa.
actualización de {src} para alerta {aid}: centro {coord}, radio error {r90}. anula el aviso original.

retraction.t: retracting {src} collab alert {aid}. not astrophysical: {reason}

blazar monitoring only. no neutrino alert link here. log and move on.

phone typing—detector note: gain drift corrected, system nominal. not tied to any neutrino alert, just an instrument update.

destello gamma terrestre detectado, no toca alertas de neutrinos. señal mala, luego mando más.

chatter.t: Dome heater's making that clicking noise. I'm going to pretend it's a lullaby and keep drinking this coffee.
Dear colleagues, might I trouble the ether with a query most pressing: has anyone seen the community biscuit tin? I fear it has wandered off.
sry for the typo. left my thermos in the truck. if u see it, pls dont drink the rest. also dome heater smells weird lol
Okay but the vending machine gave me a free extra snack and I feel like this is my real discovery.
This channel is reminded that the break room refrigerator is scheduled for cleaning. Any unattended yoghurt will be considered abandoned and disposed of accordingly.
AUTOMATED: Break-room inventory reports low biscuit stock. Human comment: tragedy, honestly.
If anyone needs me, I'm in the kitchen making toast and questioning my life choices. Dome heater can wait.
Greetings to all. The kettle is descaled, and I daresay the tea tastes less like a hardware store. Carry on.
phone died. borrowing charger. also who took my sandwich from the fridge? not cool. dome heater clicking btw
I brought leftover cake for the control room! It's on the table. Please eat before I do something regretful.
Please note that the communal coffee supplies are not for personal stockpiling. The duty desk has received complaints. This is not an operational matter.
AUTOMATED: Kitchen sensor reports fridge door ajar. Human comment: that explains the warm yoghurt.
Dome heater hum is a jazz solo. I'm tapping along. Send help or snacks.
Might anyone have a spare umbrella? I left mine by the coat rack and the walk to the car park feels rather biblical.

我中文不好，就说：这里可以聊吃的吗？我的面好了，穹顶加热器很吵，我坐车走，大家都笑笑。

でーむひーたー、まだ唸ってる。引き継ぎ後にラーメン行く？ここは雑談で流しておく。
